fullPassage: As I walked from the mailbox, my heart was beating rapidly. In my hands, I held the letter from the university I had applied to. I thought my grades were good enough to cross the line and my application letter was well-written, but was it enough? I hadn't slept a wink for days. As I carefully tore into the paper of the envelope, the letter slowly emerged with the opening phrase, "It is our great pleasure..." I shouted with joy, "I am in!" As I held the letter, I began to make a fantasy about my college life in a faraway city.

det.korean: (A) rapidly=빠르게, (B) carefully=조심스럽게, (C) joy=기쁨
det.analysis:
✅ ① rapidly — carefully — joy: 원문 일치. 심장이 빠르게(rapidly) 뛰고, 봉투를 조심스럽게(carefully) 뜯고, 기쁨(joy)으로 소리치는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② slowly — carefully — joy: (A) slowly(천천히)는 긴장으로 빠르게(rapidly) 뛰는 심장과 모순
❌ ③ rapidly — carelessly — joy: (B) carelessly(부주의하게)는 조심스럽게(carefully)와 반대
❌ ④ rapidly — carefully — sorrow: (C) sorrow(슬픔)는 합격의 기쁨(joy)과 반대
det.tip: beating rapidly(빠르게 뜀) / carefully tore(조심스럽게 뜯음) / shouted with joy(기쁨으로 소리침)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: be동사(was) 뒤 과거진행을 만드는 현재분사 beating
det.analysis: 빈칸 앞 was는 과거진행형(was + V-ing)을 이끈다. 긴장으로 심장이 빠르게 뛰고 있던 진행 상황이므로 beat → beating. was beating rapidly(빠르게 뛰고 있었다)
det.tip: 과거진행: was + V-ing. was beating rapidly

questions.passage: As I carefully __________ (tear) into the paper of the envelope, the letter slowly emerged with the opening phrase. I shouted with joy, "I am in!" As I held the letter, I began to make a fantasy about my college life in a faraway city.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 주절이 과거시제(emerged)이므로 종속절도 과거시제 tore
det.analysis: 접속사 As가 이끄는 절로, 주절의 동사 emerged(과거)와 시제를 일치시켜야 한다. tear의 과거형은 불규칙 변화로 tore. As I carefully tore into the paper(조심스럽게 봉투를 뜯자)
det.tip: tear(현재) → tore(과거) → torn(과거분사) 불규칙 변화

questions.passage: As I walked from the mailbox, my heart was beating rapidly. In my hands, I held the letter from the university I had applied to. I thought my grades were good enough to __________ and my application letter was well-written, but was it enough? I hadn't slept a wink for days. As I carefully tore into the paper of the envelope, the letter slowly emerged with the opening phrase, "It is our great pleasure..." I shouted with joy, "I am in!" As I held the letter, I began to make a fantasy about my college life in a faraway city.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: cross the line=(합격) 기준선을 넘다 — 성적이 합격선을 넘을 만큼 좋다고 생각한 맥락
det.analysis:
✅ ① cross the line: 원문 'my grades were good enough to cross the line' 일치. 성적이 합격 기준선을 넘을 만큼 좋다고 생각한 맥락 ←정답
❌ ② miss the point(요점을 놓치다): 합격 가능성과 무관
❌ ③ break the rule(규칙을 어기다): 문맥과 다름
❌ ④ lose the game(경기에서 지다): 대학 지원 맥락과 무관
det.tip: cross the line = (합격) 기준선을 넘다

questions.passage: As I walked from the mailbox, my heart was beating rapidly. In my hands, I held the letter from the university I had applied to. I thought my grades were good enough to cross the line and my application letter was well-written, but was it enough? I hadn't __________ for days. As I carefully tore into the paper of the envelope, the letter slowly emerged with the opening phrase, "It is our great pleasure..." I shouted with joy, "I am in!" As I held the letter, I began to make a fantasy about my college life in a faraway city.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: slept a wink=한숨도 자다 — 며칠 동안 한숨도 못 잤다는 맥락(not과 함께 쓰여 '전혀 못 잤다')
det.analysis:
✅ ① slept a wink: 원문 'I hadn't slept a wink for days' 일치. 결과를 기다리며 며칠 동안 한숨도 못 잤다는 맥락 ←정답
❌ ② left a note(쪽지를 남기다): 수면과 무관
❌ ③ missed a class(수업을 빠지다): 문맥과 다름
❌ ④ made a sound(소리를 내다): 잠을 못 잔 맥락과 무관
det.tip: not sleep a wink = 한숨도 못 자다
